enable_web_interface.description: Whether to enable the FreedomBox web interface (Plinth). Disable only if running headless or for security hardening.

hostname.description: Public hostname (e.g., 'myhome.freedombox.org') used for dynamic DNS and reverse proxies.

interface.description: Network interface bound to the main web service. Usually 'eth0' or 'wlan0'.

port.description: HTTP port for the Plinth web interface. Use 80 for direct access; set to 443 only with SSL.

timezone.description: System timezone (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/Berlin') for logs and service timestamps.

automatic_security_updates.description: Automatically install critical security updates. Recommended for home users.

services.description: List of services to enable on the FreedomBox. Each item defines a service name and its settings.

name.description: Service name. Must match a supported FreedomBox module.

enabled.description: Whether the service is enabled. Only enabled services render further config.

admin_user.description: Admin username (if applicable; e.g., Nextcloud, Matrix).

admin_password.description: Admin password. Leave empty for interactive setup or use a secure random generator.

data_directory.description: Path to persistent storage (e.g., Nextcloud data directory).

domain.description: Public domain for the service (e.g., 'cloud.example.com'). Required for web-facing services.

database_type.description: Database backend used by the service. 'sqlite' is simplest for home use.

onion_services.description: List of services to expose as Tor hidden services (e.g., ['http', 'matrix']).

admin_email.description: Admin email address for mail service notifications.

smtp_relay.description: External SMTP relay (e.g., 'smtp.gmail.com'). Required if using external delivery.

cups_browsing.description: Enable CUPS printer browsing over the network.

warning_percent.description: Disk usage alert threshold (percentage) for warnings.

critical_percent.description: Disk usage alert threshold (percentage) for critical alerts.

reverse_proxy.description: Configure a reverse proxy for HTTPS termination and domain routing.

enabled.description: Enable reverse proxy mode (e.g., behind a reverse proxy like Nginx or Apache).

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to SSL certificate used by the proxy.

backup.description: Automatic backup configuration for system and user data.

schedule.description: Cron expression for backup schedule (e.g., daily at 2 AM).

retention_days.description: Number of days to retain backups before auto-deletion.

exclude_patterns.description: List of file/dir patterns to skip during backup (glob patterns supported).
